risk_if_not_implemented: Without AI & Autonomous Technologies Risk Management Training, personnel are more likely to make unsafe decisions, fall victim to social engineering, mishandle data or violate requirements. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Lack of a security-minded workforce (R-SA-2), and most likely increases susceptibility to Dysfunctional Management Practices (MT-8), Human Error (MT-9), Workforce Shortage / Loss of Critical Skills / Labor Disruption (MT-25).

compensating_control_1.name: Artificial Intelligence (AI) & Autonomous Technologies Governance
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to ensure policies, processes, procedures and practices related to the mapping, measuring and managing of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Autonomous Technologies (AAT)-related risks are in place, transparent and implemented effectively.
compensating_control_1.justification: Artificial Intelligence (AI) & Autonomous Technologies Governance (AAT-02) provides detective monitoring capability that compensates for the absence of AI & Autonomous Technologies Training (SAT-05.3) by identifying unauthorized, anomalous, or non-compliant activity that the primary control would have prevented. Given the people-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Publishing Security, Compliance & Resilience Documentation
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to establish, maintain and disseminate policies, standards and procedures necessary for secure, compliant and resilient capabilities.
compensating_control_2.justification: Publishing Security, Compliance & Resilience Documentation (GOV-04) provides resilience and recovery capability that compensates for the absence of AI & Autonomous Technologies Training (SAT-05.3) by ensuring the organization can restore operations and data when the primary control is absent. Given the people-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
